cohort: The study included 172 pregnancies in Italian women with Cystic Fibrosis, focusing on those occurring between 2016 and 2023.
finding: The overall preterm birth rate was 24.1%, being higher in women with CF-related diabetes (40.6%) and lowest in those receiving CFTR modulator therapy (22.7%).
mod_finding: The overall cesarean section rate was 54.9%, peaking at 81.2% in women with CF-related diabetes.
gest_age: Includes babies born at term (>=37 weeks gestation) and preterm (<37 weeks gestation).
